note: Commerce Gift Card defines a commerce_giftcard_type config entity (config prefix commerce_giftcard.giftcard_type.*; exported keys id, label, display_label, generate.length [default 8]), the commerce_giftcard and commerce_giftcard_transaction content entities, a checkout redemption pane (commerce_giftcard_redemption) whose order processor (priority -1000) applies a commerce_giftcard adjustment, and a code generator service (commerce_giftcard.code_generator) + bulk generate form at /admin/commerce/giftcards/generate. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real commerce_giftcard_type config object. NOTE: on this shared site the commerce_giftcard entity SCHEMA is not installed (the commerce_giftcard/_transaction tables and the commerce_order 'commerce_giftcards' base field are pending install), so the eval scripts operate on the giftcard_type CONFIG object via the config API (drush cget/cset / configFactory) and avoid content-entity creation and full cache rebuilds. On a correctly installed site the same cases can be satisfied via the entity API or the admin UI.

evals.prompt: In Drupal Commerce Gift Card (commerce_giftcard), what config entity represents a kind of gift card, and which setting controls the length of the codes generated for that type? Give the config object name.
evals.expected_output: The config entity is commerce_giftcard_type (config objects commerce_giftcard.giftcard_type.<id>). Its generate.length setting controls the generated code length (default 8).

evals.prompt: How does Commerce Gift Card let a customer redeem a gift card during checkout, and how is the redeemed amount subtracted from the order total?
evals.expected_output: A checkout pane commerce_giftcard_redemption (with an inline form) collects the code; a low-priority order processor (commerce_giftcard.order_processor, priority -1000) then applies a commerce_giftcard adjustment to the order so gift cards are deducted after other adjustments.

evals.prompt: How do you bulk-generate a batch of unique gift-card codes in commerce_giftcard? Name the service or the admin form involved.
evals.expected_output: Use the Generate gift cards form at /admin/commerce/giftcards/generate (route entity.commerce_giftcard.generate_form), which uses the commerce_giftcard.code_generator service (generateCodes($type, $quantity)) to produce unique codes of the type's generate.length.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, a Commerce Gift Card type has been configured. Inspect the live gift-card type configuration and report the generated code length configured for it.
evals.expected_output: The code length is 16: commerce_giftcard.giftcard_type.cg_holiday has generate.length = 16.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, a Commerce Gift Card type has a customer-facing display label configured that differs from its admin label. Inspect the live gift-card type configuration and report the display label.
evals.expected_output: The display label is 'eGift Voucher': commerce_giftcard.giftcard_type.cg_promo has display_label = 'eGift Voucher' (admin label differs).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, create a Commerce Gift Card type with the machine id 'cg_task' and label 'Task Gift Card' whose generated codes are 12 characters long. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The config object commerce_giftcard.giftcard_type.cg_task exists with generate.length = 12 (created via GiftcardType::create([...'generate'=>['length'=>12]]) / the Add gift card type UI, or the config API).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site there is a Commerce Gift Card type with machine id 'cg_len'. Change its generated code length to 20 characters and apply the change to the live site.
